726	    #
727	    # For a chunk Δ[0..C-1], we want:
728	    #   S_local[t] = sum_{k=0..t} w^(t-k) * Δ[k]
729	    #
730	    # This is implemented as:
731	    #   S_local = Δ @ M
732	    #
733	    # where:
734	    #   M[i, j] = w^(j - i)    if j >= i
735	    #             0            otherwise
736	    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
737	    idx = torch.arange(chunk_size, device=device)
738	    row = idx[:, None]
739	    col = idx[None, :]
740	    diff = col - row
741	
742	    M = torch.zeros(chunk_size, chunk_size, device=device, dtype=dtype)
743	    mask = diff >= 0
744	
745	    if w == 0.0:
746	        M[mask & (diff == 0)] = 1.0
747	    else:
748	        M[mask] = w ** diff[mask].to(dtype)
749	
750	    # pow_vec[t] = w^(t+1), used to inject the recurrent state s_prev
751	    if w == 0.0:
752	        pow_vec = torch.zeros(chunk_size, device=device, dtype=dtype)
753	    else:
754	        pow_vec = w ** torch.arange(1, chunk_size + 1, device=device, dtype=dtype)
755	
756	    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
757	    # Parallel compute local chunk results (assuming initial state = 0)
758	    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
759	    deltas_flat = deltas_chunks.reshape(B * n_chunks, chunk_size)
760	    S_local_flat = deltas_flat @ M
761	    S_local_chunks = S_local_flat.view(B, n_chunks, chunk_size)
762	
763	    # Effective length of each chunk (the last chunk may be padded)
764	    lengths = [chunk_size] * n_chunks
765	    if pad > 0:
766	        lengths[-1] = chunk_size - pad
767	
768	    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
769	    # Recurrent propagation between chunks
770	    #
771	    # Each chunk contributes:
772	    #   S_global[t] = S_local[t] + w^(t+1) * s_prev
773	    #
774	    # And updates:
775	    #   s_prev = S_global[last_t]
776	    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
777	    S_rev = deltas_rev.new_zeros(B, T_pad)
778	    s_prev = torch.zeros(B, device=device, dtype=dtype)
779	
780	    for c in range(n_chunks):
781	        Lc = lengths[c]
782	        start = c * chunk_size
783	        end = start + Lc
784	
785	        S_local = S_local_chunks[:, c, :Lc]
786	        S_global = S_local + s_prev.unsqueeze(1) * pow_vec[:Lc]
787	
788	        S_rev[:, start:end] = S_global
789	        s_prev = S_global[:, -1]  # state for next chunk
790	
791	    # Remove padding and flip back to original time order
792	    if pad > 0:
793	        S_rev = S_rev[:, :T]
794	
795	    advantages = torch.flip(S_rev, dims=[1])
796	    returns = advantages + values
797	
798	    return advantages, returns
799	
800	
801	def calculate_log_probs_and_entropy(
802	    logits,
803	    tokens,
804	    tp_group,
805	    with_entropy: bool = False,
806	    chunk_size: int = -1,
807	    true_on_policy: bool = False,
808	    vocab_size: int | None = None,
809	):
810	    if true_on_policy:
811	        return _calculate_log_probs_and_entropy_true_on_policy(
812	            logits,
813	            tokens,
814	            tp_group,
815	            with_entropy=with_entropy,
816	            chunk_size=chunk_size,
817	            vocab_size=vocab_size,
818	        )
819	
820	    logits = logits.contiguous()
821	    # fused_vocab_parallel_cross_entropy (used by compute_log_probs) modifies
822	    # the logits tensor in-place.  Entropy forward only reads the input, and
823	    # we compute it under torch.no_grad() so no autograd graph is built —
824	    # this avoids retaining the large [T, V/TP] saved_tensors from
825	    # _VocabParallelEntropy and saves significant VRAM.
826	    entropy = None
827	    if logits.size(0) != 0:
828	        if chunk_size > 0:
829	            num_chunks = (logits.size(0) - 1) // chunk_size + 1
830	            tokens_chunks = tokens.chunk(num_chunks, dim=0)
831	            logits_chunks = logits.chunk(num_chunks, dim=0)
832	            log_probs = []
833	            entropys = []
834	            for tokens_chunk, logits_chunk in zip(tokens_chunks, logits_chunks, strict=True):
835	                if with_entropy:
836	                    with torch.no_grad():
837	                        entropys.append(compute_entropy_from_logits(logits_chunk, tp_group))
838	                log_probs.append(compute_log_probs(logits_chunk.clone(), tokens_chunk, tp_group))
839	            log_prob = torch.cat(log_probs, dim=0)
840	            if with_entropy:
841	                entropy = torch.cat(entropys, dim=0)
842	        else:
843	            if with_entropy:
844	                with torch.no_grad():
845	                    entropy = compute_entropy_from_logits(logits, tp_group)
846	                log_prob = compute_log_probs(logits.clone(), tokens, tp_group)
847	            else:
848	                log_prob = compute_log_probs(logits, tokens, tp_group)
849	    else:
850	        log_prob = logits.new_zeros((0,))
851	        if with_entropy:
852	            entropy = logits.new_zeros((0,))
853	
854	    return log_prob, entropy
855	
856	
857	def _calculate_log_probs_and_entropy_true_on_policy(
858	    logits: torch.Tensor,
859	    tokens: torch.Tensor,
860	    tp_group: dist.ProcessGroup | None,
861	    with_entropy: bool = False,
862	    chunk_size: int = -1,
863	    vocab_size: int | None = None,
864	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor | None]:
865	    """True-on-policy log-prob and entropy computation matching SGLang's scoring contract.
866	
867	    Args:
868	        logits: Aligned local logits of shape ``[R, V_local]`` (already
869	            response-sliced and temperature-scaled by ``get_responses``).
870	        tokens: Target tokens of shape ``[R]``.
871	        tp_group: Tensor-parallel process group for vocab gather.
872	        with_entropy: If True, also compute entropy.
873	        chunk_size: When > 0, process logits in chunks of this size along dim-0
874	            to avoid allocating a full ``[R, V]`` intermediate tensor (which can
875	            OOM for long responses with large vocabularies).
876	        vocab_size: Real tokenizer vocab size. If provided, padded logits are
877	            truncated after the full-vocab gather and before ``log_softmax``.
878	
879	    Returns:
880	        Tuple of ``(log_probs, entropy)`` where *log_probs* has shape ``[R]``
881	        and *entropy* has shape ``[R]`` or is ``None``.
882	    """
883	    if logits.size(0) == 0:
884	        log_prob = logits.new_zeros((0,))
885	        entropy = logits.new_zeros((0,)) if with_entropy else None
886	        return log_prob, entropy
887	
888	    if chunk_size > 0 and logits.size(0) > chunk_size:
889	        num_chunks = (logits.size(0) - 1) // chunk_size + 1
890	        logits_chunks = logits.chunk(num_chunks, dim=0)
891	        tokens_chunks = tokens.chunk(num_chunks, dim=0)
892	        log_prob_parts = []
893	        entropy_parts = []
894	        for lg, tk in zip(logits_chunks, tokens_chunks, strict=True):
895	            lp, ent = _calculate_log_probs_and_entropy_true_on_policy(
896	                lg,
897	                tk,
898	                tp_group,
899	                with_entropy=with_entropy,
900	                chunk_size=-1,
901	                vocab_size=vocab_size,
902	            )
903	            log_prob_parts.append(lp)
904	            if ent is not None:
905	                entropy_parts.append(ent)
906	        log_prob = torch.cat(log_prob_parts, dim=0)
907	        entropy = torch.cat(entropy_parts, dim=0) if with_entropy else None
908	        return log_prob, entropy
909	
910	    full_logits = _gather_true_on_policy_full_logits(logits, tp_group, vocab_size=vocab_size)
911	    _maybe_dump_top_logprob_backward("full_logits", full_logits)
912	    log_probs_full = torch.log_softmax(full_logits, dim=-1)
913	    _maybe_dump_top_logprob_backward("log_probs_full", log_probs_full)
914	    log_prob = torch.gather(log_probs_full, dim=-1, index=tokens.unsqueeze(-1)).squeeze(-1)
915	    _maybe_dump_top_logprob_backward("log_prob", log_prob)
916	
917	    entropy = None
918	    if with_entropy:
919	        probs = log_probs_full.exp()
920	        entropy = -(probs * log_probs_full).sum(dim=-1)
921	
922	    return log_prob, entropy

1999	    datasets_config = []

2001	
2002	    if args.eval_config:

2004	
2005	        cfg = OmegaConf.load(args.eval_config)
2006	        cfg_dict = OmegaConf.to_container(cfg, resolve=True)
2007	        if not isinstance(cfg_dict, dict):
2008	            raise ValueError("--eval-config must contain a mapping at the root.")
2009	
2010	        eval_cfg = cfg_dict.get("eval", cfg_dict)
2011	        if not isinstance(eval_cfg, dict):

2022	            values = ["aime", values[0]]
2023	        if len(values) % 2 != 0:
2024	            raise ValueError("eval prompt data must be provided as name/path pairs.")
2025	        
2026	        # Merge paths for the same dataset name
2027	        datasets_map = {}
2028	        for i in range(0, len(values), 2):
2029	            name = values[i]
2030	            path = values[i + 1]
2031	            if name in datasets_map:
2032	                existing_path = datasets_map[name]["path"]
2033	                if isinstance(existing_path, list):
2034	                    existing_path.append(path)
2035	                else:
2036	                    datasets_map[name]["path"] = [existing_path, path]
2037	            else:
2038	                datasets_map[name] = {"name": name, "path": path}

        def add_user_provided_function_arguments(parser):
            try:
                args_partial, _ = parser.parse_known_args()
            except SystemExit:
                return parser
            for path in [
                args_partial.rollout_function_path,
                args_partial.custom_generate_function_path,
            ]:
                try:
                    fn = load_function(path)
                except (ModuleNotFoundError, ValueError):
                    continue
                if fn is not None and callable(getattr(fn, "add_arguments", None)):
                    fn.add_arguments(parser)
            return parser

        def add_sglang_tp_size():
            temp_parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(add_help=False)
            temp_parser.add_argument("--rollout-num-gpus-per-engine", type=int, default=1)
            temp_args, _ = temp_parser.parse_known_args()
            sglang_tp_size = temp_args.rollout_num_gpus_per_engine
            return sglang_tp_size

        if add_custom_arguments is not None:
            parser = add_custom_arguments(parser)

        parser = add_cluster_arguments(parser)

        parser = add_network_arguments(parser)

        parser = add_rollout_buffer_arguments(parser)
        parser = add_mtp_training_arguments(parser)
        parser = add_prefill_decode_disaggregation_arguments(parser)
        parser = add_ci_arguments(parser)
        parser = add_custom_megatron_plugins_arguments(parser)
        if enable_experimental_rollout_refactor():
            parser = add_user_provided_function_arguments(parser)

        reset_arg(
            parser,
            "--custom-config-path",
            type=str,
            default=None,
            help="Path to the YAML config for custom function arguments.",
        )
        reset_arg(parser, "--padded-vocab-size", type=int, default=None)

        parser.set_defaults(sglang_tensor_parallel_size=add_sglang_tp_size())
        return parser

    return add_miles_arguments


def parse_args(add_custom_arguments=None):
    # Users may call `parse_args` very early, thus we ensure logger is configured here
    configure_logger()

    add_miles_arguments = get_miles_extra_args_provider(add_custom_arguments)

    backend = parse_args_train_backend()
    if backend == "megatron":
        from miles.backends.megatron_utils.arguments import parse_args as megatron_parse_args
        from miles.backends.megatron_utils.arguments import set_default_megatron_args
        from miles.backends.megatron_utils.arguments import validate_args as megatron_validate_args

        args = megatron_parse_args(extra_args_provider=add_miles_arguments)
        if args.hf_checkpoint:
            hf_config = AutoConfig.from_pretrained(args.hf_checkpoint, trust_remote_code=True)
            hf_validate_args(args, hf_config)

        args.rank = 0
        args.world_size = args.actor_num_nodes * args.actor_num_gpus_per_node
        args = set_default_megatron_args(args)
    else:
        from miles.backends.experimental.fsdp_utils.arguments import load_fsdp_args

        args = load_fsdp_args(extra_args_provider=add_miles_arguments)
        args.rank = 0  # Primary process rank for wandb initialization
        args.world_size = args.actor_num_nodes * args.actor_num_gpus_per_node

        assert args.context_parallel_size == 1, "Context parallelism is not supported for FSDP backend."

        if not args.ci_test:
            raise ValueError(
                "The FSDP backend has known issues with SGLang v0.5.10 and is not actively maintained in the current version. "
                "It has been moved to miles.backends.experimental. "
                "Contributions are welcome if you are interested in improving it."
            )

    miles_validate_args(args)

    if backend == "megatron":
        megatron_validate_args(args)

        # always use varlen
        args.variable_seq_lengths = True
        if getattr(args, "moe_token_dispatcher_type", None) == "allgather":
            logger.info(
                "--moe-token-dispatcher-type allgather does not support variable sequence length, "
                "please use alltoall dispatcher instead."
            )
            args.moe_token_dispatcher_type = "alltoall"

        if args.pipeline_model_parallel_size == 1:
            assert args.decoder_first_pipeline_num_layers is None and args.decoder_last_pipeline_num_layers is None, (
                "decoder_first_pipeline_num_layers and decoder_last_pipeline_num_layers should be None when "
                "pipeline_model_parallel_size is 1."
            )

    sglang_validate_args(args)

    return args


def parse_args_train_backend():
    if os.environ.get("MILES_BACKEND") is not None:
        raise Exception("`MILES_BACKEND` is deprecated, please use --train-backend directly.")

    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    get_miles_extra_args_provider()(parser)
    args_partial, _ = parser.parse_known_args()
    return args_partial.train_backend


def _resolve_eval_datasets(args) -> list[EvalDatasetConfig]:
    """
    Build evaluation dataset configurations from either --eval-config or --eval-prompt-data.
    """
    datasets_config = []
    defaults: dict[str, Any] = {}

    if args.eval_config:
        from omegaconf import OmegaConf

        cfg = OmegaConf.load(args.eval_config)
        cfg_dict = OmegaConf.to_container(cfg, resolve=True)
        if not isinstance(cfg_dict, dict):
            raise ValueError("--eval-config must contain a mapping at the root.")

        eval_cfg = cfg_dict.get("eval", cfg_dict)
        if not isinstance(eval_cfg, dict):
            raise ValueError("--eval-config must define an `eval` mapping or be a mapping itself.")

        defaults = dict(eval_cfg.get("defaults") or {})
        datasets_config = ensure_dataset_list(eval_cfg.get("datasets"))
        if not datasets_config:
            raise ValueError("--eval-config does not define any datasets under `eval.datasets`.")
    elif args.eval_prompt_data:
        values = list(args.eval_prompt_data)
        if len(values) == 1:
            logger.info("[legacy] only one eval_prompt_data detected, will assume it is data for aime")
            values = ["aime", values[0]]
        if len(values) % 2 != 0:
            raise ValueError("eval prompt data must be provided as name/path pairs.")
        
        # Merge paths for the same dataset name
        datasets_map = {}
        for i in range(0, len(values), 2):
            name = values[i]
            path = values[i + 1]
            if name in datasets_map:
                existing_path = datasets_map[name]["path"]
                if isinstance(existing_path, list):
                    existing_path.append(path)
                else:
                    datasets_map[name]["path"] = [existing_path, path]
            else:
                datasets_map[name] = {"name": name, "path": path}
        datasets_config = list(datasets_map.values())
    else:
        datasets_config = []

    eval_datasets = build_eval_dataset_configs(args, datasets_config, defaults)
    if eval_datasets:
        args.eval_prompt_data = [item for dataset in eval_datasets for item in (dataset.name, dataset.path)]
    else:
        args.eval_prompt_data = None

    return eval_datasets


def miles_validate_args(args):
    args.eval_datasets = _resolve_eval_datasets(args)

    if args.recompute_logprobs_via_prefill:
        assert args.true_on_policy_mode, "--recompute-logprobs-via-prefill requires --true-on-policy-mode"

    # Normalize --tito-allowed-append-roles: lowercase + deduplicate.
    raw_roles = getattr(args, "tito_allowed_append_roles", ["tool"])
    args.tito_allowed_append_roles = sorted(set(r.lower() for r in raw_roles))

    if not args.use_session_server:
        misconfigured = []
        if args.tito_model != TITOTokenizerType.DEFAULT.value:
            misconfigured.append(f"--tito-model={args.tito_model}")
        if args.tito_allowed_append_roles != ["tool"]:
            misconfigured.append(f"--tito-allowed-append-roles={args.tito_allowed_append_roles}")
        if misconfigured:
            raise ValueError(
                f"{', '.join(misconfigured)} require --use-session-server; "
                "these flags only configure the session-server TITO middleware."
            )

    if "user" in args.tito_allowed_append_roles:
        logger.warning(
            "--tito-allowed-append-roles includes 'user'. "
            "Incremental tokenization assumes appended messages do not change how "
            "earlier turns render, which may not hold for user messages on "
            "context-sensitive chat templates (e.g. last_query_index logic, "
            "thinking-token trimming). This can cause input_ids to diverge from "
            "the canonical template output. Use at your own risk."
        )

    if args.debug_disable_optimizer:
        args.no_load_optim = True
        args.no_save_optim = True

    # Normalize the deprecated ``--chat-template-path=autofix`` alias to None
    # up-front so the rest of this block treats it as "no path given".
    if args.chat_template_path == "autofix":
        logger.warning(
            "--chat-template-path=autofix is deprecated; remove the flag and rely "
            "on --tito-model + --tito-allowed-append-roles to auto-resolve. The "
            "alias will be removed in a future release."
        )
        args.chat_template_path = None

    # Auto-resolve a bundled fixed chat-template only when:
    #   1. the caller did NOT pass --chat-template-path (an explicit path always
    #      wins and is never overridden)
    #   2. the caller chose a non-default --tito-model family (DEFAULT means
    #      "use the model's native HF chat template", which is loaded by
    #      AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained — no override needed here)
    should_auto_resolve = args.chat_template_path is None and args.tito_model != TITOTokenizerType.DEFAULT.value

    if should_auto_resolve:
        tito_model = TITOTokenizerType(args.tito_model)
        from miles.utils.chat_template_utils import resolve_fixed_chat_template

        resolved_path, resolved_kwargs = resolve_fixed_chat_template(
            tito_model,
            allowed_append_roles=args.tito_allowed_append_roles,
        )
        if resolved_path is not None:
            args.chat_template_path = resolved_path
        # Merge inferred kwargs.  User-explicit values win on conflict; only
        # keys the user did not set are auto-filled.
        if resolved_kwargs:
            user_kwargs = args.apply_chat_template_kwargs or {}
            for key, value in resolved_kwargs.items():
                if key in user_kwargs:
                    continue
                user_kwargs[key] = value
                logger.warning(
                    "Auto-set --apply-chat-template-kwargs %s=%r for tito_model=%s "
                    "(allowed_append_roles=%s); pass an explicit value to override.",
                    key,
                    value,
                    tito_model.value,
                    sorted(args.tito_allowed_append_roles),
                )
            args.apply_chat_template_kwargs = user_kwargs

    if args.chat_template_path is not None:
        if not os.path.isfile(args.chat_template_path):
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"--chat-template-path file not found: {args.chat_template_path}")
        args.sglang_chat_template = args.chat_template_path

    if args.kl_coef != 0 or args.use_kl_loss:
        if not os.path.exists(args.ref_load):
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"ref_load {args.ref_load} does not exist, please check the path.")

        if not os.path.exists(os.path.join(args.ref_load, "latest_checkpointed_iteration.txt")):
            logger.info(
                f"ref_load {args.ref_load} does not have latest_checkpointed_iteration.txt, "
                "please make sure it is a valid megatron checkpoint directory."
            )

    # TODO: During loading, we need to set the start_rollout_id here.
    if args.megatron_to_hf_mode == "bridge":
        if args.load is None:
            args.load = args.ref_load or args.hf_checkpoint
        args.start_rollout_id = 0
    else:
        if (
            args.load is None
            or not os.path.exists(args.load)
            or not os.path.exists(os.path.join(args.load, "latest_checkpointed_iteration.txt"))
        ):
            args.no_load_optim = True
            args.no_load_rng = True
            args.finetune = True
            args.load = args.ref_load
            if args.ref_ckpt_step is not None:
                args.ckpt_step = args.ref_ckpt_step
            args.start_rollout_id = 0

    if args.eval_interval is not None:
        assert args.eval_datasets, "Evaluation datasets must be configured when eval_interval is set."

    if args.save_interval is not None:
        assert args.save is not None, "'--save' is required when save_interval is set."

    # Parse LoRA target modules
    if args.lora_rank > 0:
        assert args.target_modules is not None, "'--target-modules' is required when LoRA is enabled."

        if args.target_modules == "all-linear":
            modules = ["q_proj", "k_proj", "v_proj", "o_proj", "gate_proj", "up_proj", "down_proj"]
        elif "," in args.target_modules:
            modules = [m.strip() for m in args.target_modules.split(",")]
        else:
            modules = [args.target_modules]

        if args.exclude_modules:
            exclude_set = (
                set(m.strip() for m in args.exclude_modules.split(","))
                if "," in args.exclude_modules
                else {args.exclude_modules}
            )
            modules = [m for m in modules if m not in exclude_set]

        args.target_modules = modules

    assert not (args.kl_coef != 0 and args.kl_loss_coef != 0), "Only one of kl_coef and kl_loss_coef can be set"

    if args.advantage_estimator in ["reinforce_plus_plus", "reinforce_plus_plus_baseline"]:
        assert args.normalize_advantages, (
            "The 'reinforce_plus_plus' and 'reinforce_plus_plus_baseline' advantage estimators "
            "require advantage normalization. Please add `--normalize-advantages` to your command."
        )

    if args.use_rollout_logprobs:
        assert not args.use_tis, "use_rollout_logprobs and use_tis cannot be set at the same time."

    if args.get_mismatch_metrics:
        assert (
            args.custom_tis_function_path is not None
        ), "custom_tis_function_path must be set when get_mismatch_metrics is set"

        if args.use_rollout_logprobs:
            logger.info(
                "get_mismatch_metrics is set; For metrics calculation, the log probs will still be recomputed by training engine. One more forward pass will be applied."
            )

    if args.use_dynamic_batch_size:
        assert args.max_tokens_per_gpu is not None, "max_tokens_per_gpu must be set when use_dynamic_batch_size is set"
        if args.log_probs_max_tokens_per_gpu is None:
            args.log_probs_max_tokens_per_gpu = args.max_tokens_per_gpu

    if args.eps_clip_high is None:
        args.eps_clip_high = args.eps_clip

    if args.eval_reward_key is None:
        args.eval_reward_key = args.reward_key

    if args.dump_details is not None:
        args.save_debug_rollout_data = f"{args.dump_details}/rollout_data/{{rollout_id}}.pt"
        args.save_debug_train_data = f"{args.dump_details}/train_data/{{rollout_id}}_{{rank}}.pt"

    if args.load_debug_rollout_data is not None:
        logger.info(
            f"load_debug_rollout_data {args.load_debug_rollout_data} is set, "
            "will not instantiate sglang servers and will only run the training process."
        )
        args.debug_train_only = True

    args.use_critic = args.advantage_estimator == "ppo"
    if args.critic_num_gpus_per_node is None:
        args.critic_num_gpus_per_node = args.actor_num_gpus_per_node
    if args.critic_num_nodes is None:
        args.critic_num_nodes = args.actor_num_nodes
    if args.critic_load is None:
        args.critic_load = args.load
    if args.critic_lr is None:
        args.critic_lr = args.lr

    if args.offload:
        args.offload_train = True
        args.offload_rollout = True
    del args.offload

    if args.debug_rollout_only:
        if args.colocate and (not args.rollout_num_gpus):
            args.rollout_num_gpus = args.actor_num_gpus_per_node * args.actor_num_nodes
        else:
            args.actor_num_gpus_per_node = min(8, args.rollout_num_gpus)
            args.actor_num_nodes = args.rollout_num_gpus // args.actor_num_gpus_per_node
        args.colocate = False
        args.offload_train = args.offload_rollout = False
        if args.train_memory_margin_bytes > 0:
            logger.warning("Force train_memory_margin_bytes=0 since debug_rollout_only does not support it")
            args.train_memory_margin_bytes = 0

    assert not (args.debug_rollout_only and args.debug_train_only), (
        "debug_rollout_only and debug_train_only cannot be set at the same time, " "please set only one of them."
    )

    # always true on offload for colocate at the moment.
    if args.update_weight_transfer_mode == "p2p":
        assert not args.colocate, (
            "P2P weight transfer mode is not compatible with --colocate. "
            "Please use broadcast mode or disable colocate."
        )
        assert (
            getattr(args, "prefill_num_servers", None) is None
        ), "P2P weight transfer mode has not been tested when PD is enabled."

    if args.colocate:
        if args.offload_train is None:
            args.offload_train = True
        if args.offload_rollout is None:
            args.offload_rollout = True
        if args.sglang_enforce_piecewise_cuda_graph:
            logger.warning("Warning: colocate mode with --sglang-enforce-piecewise-cuda-graph may trigger NVLS OOM.")
        if not args.sglang_disable_piecewise_cuda_graph:
            args.sglang_disable_piecewise_cuda_graph = True
            logger.info(
                "Colocate mode: defaulting --sglang-disable-piecewise-cuda-graph to avoid NVLS OOM. "
                "Use --sglang-enforce-piecewise-cuda-graph to override."
            )
        if args.rollout_num_gpus != args.actor_num_gpus_per_node * args.actor_num_nodes:
            logger.info(
                f"rollout_num_gpus {args.rollout_num_gpus} != actor_num_gpus_per_node {args.actor_num_gpus_per_node} "
                f"* actor_num_nodes {args.actor_num_nodes}, overriding rollout_num_gpus to match actor_num_gpus_per_node * actor_num_nodes."
            )
            args.rollout_num_gpus = args.actor_num_gpus_per_node * args.actor_num_nodes
            if args.use_critic:
                args.rollout_num_gpus += args.critic_num_gpus_per_node * args.critic_num_nodes

    if args.offload_train is None:
        args.offload_train = False
    if args.offload_rollout is None:
        args.offload_rollout = False

    if args.offload_train:
        args.disable_grad_buffers_cpu_backup = True
        args.disable_param_buffers_cpu_backup = args.enable_weights_backuper

    if args.eval_function_path is None:
        args.eval_function_path = args.rollout_function_path

    if args.num_steps_per_rollout is not None:
        global_batch_size = args.rollout_batch_size * args.n_samples_per_prompt // args.num_steps_per_rollout
        if args.global_batch_size is not None:
            assert args.global_batch_size == global_batch_size, (
                f"global_batch_size {args.global_batch_size} is not equal to "
                f"rollout_batch_size {args.rollout_batch_size} * n_samples_per_prompt {args.n_samples_per_prompt} "
                f"// num_steps_per_rollout {args.num_steps_per_rollout}"
            )
        args.global_batch_size = global_batch_size

    if args.n_samples_per_prompt == 1:
        args.grpo_std_normalization = False
        logger.info("n_samples_per_prompt is set to 1, grpo_std_normalization will be set to False.")

    if args.over_sampling_batch_size is None:
        args.over_sampling_batch_size = args.rollout_batch_size

    assert args.over_sampling_batch_size >= args.rollout_batch_size, (
        f"over_sampling_batch_size {args.over_sampling_batch_size} should be greater than or equal to "
        f"rollout_batch_size {args.rollout_batch_size}"
    )

    if args.num_epoch is not None:
        if args.num_rollout is not None:
            logger.info("Both num_epoch and num_rollout are set, num_epoch will be ignored.")
        else:
            assert args.rollout_global_dataset, (
                "num_epoch is set, but rollout_global_dataset is not set, "
                "please remove --disable-rollout-global-dataset to use num_epoch"
            )
    else:
        # if num_epoch is not set, we should set num_rollout
        assert args.num_rollout is not None, (
            "num_epoch is not set, but num_rollout is not set, " "please set --num-rollout or --num-epoch"
        )

    if args.enable_mtp_training:
        assert args.mtp_num_layers, "mtp_num_layers must be set when enable_mtp_training is set"

    if args.use_rollout_routing_replay:
        args.use_routing_replay = True

    if args.custom_config_path:
        with open(args.custom_config_path) as f:
            data = yaml.safe_load(f) or {}
        for k, v in data.items():
            if hasattr(args, k):
                logger.info(f"Warning: Argument {k} is already set to {getattr(args, k)}, will override with {v}.")
            setattr(args, k, v)

    if args.eval_max_context_len is None:
        logger.info(
            f"args.eval_max_context_len is not set. Use args.rollout_max_context_len {args.rollout_max_context_len} as default value."
        )
        args.eval_max_context_len = args.rollout_max_context_len

    if args.rollout_max_context_len is not None:
        if args.rollout_max_prompt_len is None:
            args.rollout_max_prompt_len = args.rollout_max_context_len - 1
            logger.info(
                f"args.rollout_max_prompt_len is not set. Use args.rollout_max_context_len - 1 ({args.rollout_max_context_len} - 1) as default value so that there is at least one generated token to compute loss."
            )
        assert (
            args.rollout_max_prompt_len <= args.rollout_max_context_len - 1
        ), f"args.rollout_max_prompt_len ({args.rollout_max_prompt_len}) must be smaller than args.rollout_max_context_len ({args.rollout_max_context_len}) so that there is at least one generated token to compute loss."

    assert not (
        args.prefill_num_servers is not None and args.rollout_external
    ), "prefill_num_servers cannot be set when rollout_external is set."

    assert not (
        getattr(args, "sglang_config", None) is not None and args.rollout_external
    ), "sglang_config cannot be set when rollout_external is set."

    assert not (
        getattr(args, "sglang_config", None) is not None and getattr(args, "prefill_num_servers", None) is not None
    ), "sglang_config and prefill_num_servers are mutually exclusive. Use server_groups in the YAML config instead."

    if args.qkv_format == "bshd":
        assert args.train_backend == "megatron", "bshd format is only supported for megatron backend."
        assert (
            args.use_dynamic_batch_size is False
        ), "Dynamic batch size is not supported for bshd format. Please specify --micro-batch-size instead."

    if getattr(args, "log_rollout_mbu", False):
        assert args.rollout_mbu_poll_interval_seconds > 0, "rollout_mbu_poll_interval_seconds must be positive."
        assert args.rollout_mbu_dtype_bytes > 0, "rollout_mbu_dtype_bytes must be positive."
        if not getattr(args, "sglang_enable_metrics", False):
            logger.info("Enable SGLang /metrics automatically because --log-rollout-mbu is set.")
            args.sglang_enable_metrics = True

    _maybe_apply_dumper_overrides(args)


def _maybe_apply_dumper_overrides(args) -> None:
    if not args.dumper_enable:
        return

    if args.use_fault_tolerance:
        logger.info("Dumper mode: disabling --use-fault-tolerance to suppress RolloutHealthMonitor heartbeats")
        args.use_fault_tolerance = False

    logger.info("Dumper mode: all heartbeat mechanisms disabled")
    args.router_disable_health_check = True
    args.rollout_health_check_interval = 1e18

    if args.start_rollout_id is None:
        args.start_rollout_id = 0

    args.num_rollout = (args.start_rollout_id or 0) + 1
    logger.info(
        "Dumper mode: forced rollout range [%d, %d), disabled eval and save",
        args.start_rollout_id,
        args.num_rollout,
    )
    args.eval_interval = None
    args.save = None
    args.save_interval = None
    args.save_retain_interval = None


def hf_validate_args(args, hf_config):
    def equal(x, y):
        return x == y

    def get_megatron_arg(name: str):
        """Resolve Megatron CLI arg name (e.g. norm_epsilon vs layernorm_epsilon)."""
        if hasattr(args, name):
            return getattr(args, name)
        if name == "layernorm_epsilon" and hasattr(args, "norm_epsilon"):
            return args.norm_epsilon
        if name == "norm_epsilon" and hasattr(args, "layernorm_epsilon"):
            return args.layernorm_epsilon
        raise AttributeError(f"Namespace has no attribute {name!r}")

    errors = []

    # multimodal models have different config structure
    if hasattr(hf_config, "text_config"):
        hf_config = hf_config.text_config

    if hasattr(hf_config, "rope_parameters") and isinstance(hf_config.rope_parameters, dict):
        if "rope_theta" in hf_config.rope_parameters:
            hf_config.rope_theta = hf_config.rope_parameters["rope_theta"]

    for hf_config_name, megatron_config_name, compare_fn in [
        ("hidden_size", "hidden_size", equal),
        ("num_attention_heads", "num_attention_heads", equal),
        ("num_hidden_layers", "num_layers", equal),
        ("intermediate_size", "ffn_hidden_size", equal),
        ("tie_word_embeddings", "untie_embeddings_and_output_weights", lambda x, y: not x == y),
        (
            "rms_norm_eps",
            "norm_epsilon" if os.getenv("DEPRECATED_MEGATRON_COMPATIBLE", "0") == "1" else "layernorm_epsilon",
            equal,
        ),
        ("rope_theta", "rotary_base", equal),
    ]:
        # FIXME: Qwen3.5 transfomers has bug.
        if getattr(hf_config, "model_type", "") == "qwen3_5_moe_text" and hf_config_name == "intermediate_size":
            continue
        if hasattr(hf_config, hf_config_name):
            if not compare_fn(getattr(hf_config, hf_config_name), get_megatron_arg(megatron_config_name)):
                errors.append(
                    f"{hf_config_name} in hf config {getattr(hf_config, hf_config_name)} is not equal to "
                    f"{megatron_config_name} {get_megatron_arg(megatron_config_name)}, please check the config."
                )

    if len(errors) > 0:
        raise AssertionError("hf_validate_args failed: " + "; ".join(errors))

1995	def _resolve_eval_datasets(args) -> list[EvalDatasetConfig]:
1996	    """
1997	    Build evaluation dataset configurations from either --eval-config or --eval-prompt-data.
1998	    """
1999	    datasets_config = []
2000	    defaults: dict[str, Any] = {}
2001	
2002	    if args.eval_config:
2003	        from omegaconf import OmegaConf
2004	
2005	        cfg = OmegaConf.load(args.eval_config)
2006	        cfg_dict = OmegaConf.to_container(cfg, resolve=True)
2007	        if not isinstance(cfg_dict, dict):
2008	            raise ValueError("--eval-config must contain a mapping at the root.")
2009	
2010	        eval_cfg = cfg_dict.get("eval", cfg_dict)
2011	        if not isinstance(eval_cfg, dict):
2012	            raise ValueError("--eval-config must define an `eval` mapping or be a mapping itself.")
2013	
2014	        defaults = dict(eval_cfg.get("defaults") or {})
2015	        datasets_config = ensure_dataset_list(eval_cfg.get("datasets"))
2016	        if not datasets_config:
2017	            raise ValueError("--eval-config does not define any datasets under `eval.datasets`.")
2018	    elif args.eval_prompt_data:
2019	        values = list(args.eval_prompt_data)
2020	        if len(values) == 1:
2021	            logger.info("[legacy] only one eval_prompt_data detected, will assume it is data for aime")
2022	            values = ["aime", values[0]]
2023	        if len(values) % 2 != 0:
2024	            raise ValueError("eval prompt data must be provided as name/path pairs.")
2025	        
2026	        # Merge paths for the same dataset name
2027	        datasets_map = {}
2028	        for i in range(0, len(values), 2):
2029	            name = values[i]
2030	            path = values[i + 1]
2031	            if name in datasets_map:
2032	                existing_path = datasets_map[name]["path"]
2033	                if isinstance(existing_path, list):
2034	                    existing_path.append(path)
2035	                else:
2036	                    datasets_map[name]["path"] = [existing_path, path]
2037	            else:
2038	                datasets_map[name] = {"name": name, "path": path}
2039	        datasets_config = list(datasets_map.values())
2040	    else:
2041	        datasets_config = []
2042	
2043	    eval_datasets = build_eval_dataset_configs(args, datasets_config, defaults)
2044	    if eval_datasets:
2045	        args.eval_prompt_data = [item for dataset in eval_datasets for item in (dataset.name, dataset.path)]
2046	    else:
2047	        args.eval_prompt_data = None
2048	
2049	    return eval_datasets

2052	def miles_validate_args(args):
2053	    args.eval_datasets = _resolve_eval_datasets(args)
2054	
2055	    if args.recompute_logprobs_via_prefill:
2056	        assert args.true_on_policy_mode, "--recompute-logprobs-via-prefill requires --true-on-policy-mode"
2057	
2058	    # Normalize --tito-allowed-append-roles: lowercase + deduplicate.
2059	    raw_roles = getattr(args, "tito_allowed_append_roles", ["tool"])
2060	    args.tito_allowed_append_roles = sorted(set(r.lower() for r in raw_roles))
2061	
2062	    if not args.use_session_server:
2063	        misconfigured = []
2064	        if args.tito_model != TITOTokenizerType.DEFAULT.value:
2065	            misconfigured.append(f"--tito-model={args.tito_model}")
2066	        if args.tito_allowed_append_roles != ["tool"]:
2067	            misconfigured.append(f"--tito-allowed-append-roles={args.tito_allowed_append_roles}")
2068	        if misconfigured:
2069	            raise ValueError(
2070	                f"{', '.join(misconfigured)} require --use-session-server; "
2071	                "these flags only configure the session-server TITO middleware."
2072	            )
2073	
2074	    if "user" in args.tito_allowed_append_roles:
2075	        logger.warning(
2076	            "--tito-allowed-append-roles includes 'user'. "
2077	            "Incremental tokenization assumes appended messages do not change how "
2078	            "earlier turns render, which may not hold for user messages on "
2079	            "context-sensitive chat templates (e.g. last_query_index logic, "
2080	            "thinking-token trimming). This can cause input_ids to diverge from "
2081	            "the canonical template output. Use at your own risk."
2082	        )
2083	
2084	    if args.debug_disable_optimizer:
2085	        args.no_load_optim = True
2086	        args.no_save_optim = True
2087	
2088	    # Normalize the deprecated ``--chat-template-path=autofix`` alias to None
2089	    # up-front so the rest of this block treats it as "no path given".
2090	    if args.chat_template_path == "autofix":
2091	        logger.warning(
2092	            "--chat-template-path=autofix is deprecated; remove the flag and rely "
2093	            "on --tito-model + --tito-allowed-append-roles to auto-resolve. The "
2094	            "alias will be removed in a future release."
2095	        )
2096	        args.chat_template_path = None
2097	
2098	    # Auto-resolve a bundled fixed chat-template only when:
2099	    #   1. the caller did NOT pass --chat-template-path (an explicit path always
2100	    #      wins and is never overridden)
2101	    #   2. the caller chose a non-default --tito-model family (DEFAULT means
2102	    #      "use the model's native HF chat template", which is loaded by
2103	    #      AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained — no override needed here)
2104	    should_auto_resolve = args.chat_template_path is None and args.tito_model != TITOTokenizerType.DEFAULT.value
2105	
2106	    if should_auto_resolve:
2107	        tito_model = TITOTokenizerType(args.tito_model)
2108	        from miles.utils.chat_template_utils import resolve_fixed_chat_template
2109	
2110	        resolved_path, resolved_kwargs = resolve_fixed_chat_template(
2111	            tito_model,
2112	            allowed_append_roles=args.tito_allowed_append_roles,
2113	        )
2114	        if resolved_path is not None:
2115	            args.chat_template_path = resolved_path
2116	        # Merge inferred kwargs.  User-explicit values win on conflict; only
2117	        # keys the user did not set are auto-filled.
2118	        if resolved_kwargs:
2119	            user_kwargs = args.apply_chat_template_kwargs or {}
2120	            for key, value in resolved_kwargs.items():
2121	                if key in user_kwargs:
2122	                    continue
2123	                user_kwargs[key] = value
2124	                logger.warning(
2125	                    "Auto-set --apply-chat-template-kwargs %s=%r for tito_model=%s "
2126	                    "(allowed_append_roles=%s); pass an explicit value to override.",
2127	                    key,
2128	                    value,
2129	                    tito_model.value,
2130	                    sorted(args.tito_allowed_append_roles),
2131	                )
2132	            args.apply_chat_template_kwargs = user_kwargs
2133	
2134	    if args.chat_template_path is not None:

import json

"

steps.message: Interesting — so there are small nonzero advantages on ~70% of steps (so there IS some gradient), but the `rewards` metric is exactly 0.0 on **every** step. The advantage values are tiny (max 0.075) compared to what GRPO group-mean-centered advantages should look like (±0.5 range for binary rewards). 470	def aggregate_train_losses(
471	    losses_reduced: list[dict[str, list[str] | torch.Tensor]],
472	) -> dict[str, float]:
473	    """Aggregate loss metrics across micro-batches.
474	
475	    Sums loss values across all micro-batches, performs all-reduce across
476	    the data-parallel group, and computes per-sample/token averages.
477	
478	    Args:
479	        losses_reduced: List of log_dict from each micro-batch.
480	            Each log_dict has format: {"keys": list[str], "values": torch.Tensor}
481	        parallel_state: Parallel state containing dp_group and cp_size.
482	
483	    Returns:
484	        Dictionary mapping metric names to averaged values.
485	    """
486	    parallel_state = get_parallel_state()
487	    if not losses_reduced:
488	        return {}
489	
490	    keys = losses_reduced[0]["keys"]
491	    local_has_logdiff = any("train_rollout_kl" in log_dict["keys"] for log_dict in losses_reduced)
492	
493	    values = None
494	    weighted_metrics = None
495	    logdiff_histogram = None
496	    logdiff_min_max = None
497	    for log_dict in losses_reduced:
498	        if values is None:
499	            values = log_dict["values"].clone()
500	        else:
501	            values += log_dict["values"]
502	
503	        for key, metric_value in log_dict.get("weighted_metrics", {}).items():
504	            if weighted_metrics is None:
505	                weighted_metrics = {}
506	            metric_value = metric_value.to(device=values.device, dtype=torch.float64)
507	            if key not in weighted_metrics:
508	                weighted_metrics[key] = metric_value.clone()
509	            else:
510	                weighted_metrics[key] += metric_value
511	
512	        if "logdiff_histogram" in log_dict:
513	            metric_histogram = log_dict["logdiff_histogram"].to(device=values.device, dtype=torch.float64)
514	            if logdiff_histogram is None:
515	                logdiff_histogram = metric_histogram.clone()
516	            else:
517	                logdiff_histogram += metric_histogram
518	
519	        if "logdiff_min_max" in log_dict:
520	            metric_min_max = log_dict["logdiff_min_max"].to(device=values.device, dtype=torch.float64)
521	            if logdiff_min_max is None:
522	                logdiff_min_max = metric_min_max.clone()
523	            else:
524	                logdiff_min_max[0] = torch.minimum(logdiff_min_max[0], metric_min_max[0])
525	                logdiff_min_max[1] = torch.maximum(logdiff_min_max[1], metric_min_max[1])
526	
527	    assert len(keys) + 1 == values.numel(), f"Expected {len(keys) + 1} values, got {values.numel()}"
528	
529	    dist.all_reduce(values, op=dist.ReduceOp.SUM, group=parallel_state.intra_dp_cp.group)
530	
531	    logdiff_flag = torch.tensor([1 if local_has_logdiff else 0], device=values.device, dtype=torch.int32)
532	    dist.all_reduce(logdiff_flag, op=dist.ReduceOp.MAX, group=parallel_state.intra_dp_cp.group)
533	    logdiff_active = bool(logdiff_flag.item())
534	
535	    if logdiff_active:
536	        reduced_weighted: dict[str, torch.Tensor] = {}
537	        for key in _LOGDIFF_WEIGHTED_METRIC_KEYS:
538	            if weighted_metrics is not None and key in weighted_metrics:
539	                metric_value = weighted_metrics[key].to(device=values.device, dtype=torch.float64)
540	            else:
541	                metric_value = torch.zeros(2, device=values.device, dtype=torch.float64)
542	            dist.all_reduce(metric_value, op=dist.ReduceOp.SUM, group=parallel_state.intra_dp_cp.group)
543	            reduced_weighted[key] = metric_value
544	        weighted_metrics = reduced_weighted
545	    elif weighted_metrics:
546	        for key in sorted(weighted_metrics.keys()):
547	            metric_value = weighted_metrics[key].to(device=values.device, dtype=torch.float64)
548	            dist.all_reduce(metric_value, op=dist.ReduceOp.SUM, group=parallel_state.intra_dp_cp.group)
549	            weighted_metrics[key] = metric_value
550	
551	    # logdiff_active is agreed group-wide above (MAX over intra_dp_cp), so every rank
552	    # runs the identical logdiff collective schedule even when its own first micro-batch
553	    # lacked train_rollout_kl or had zero local tokens (prevents the NumelIn=4097 hang).
554	    if logdiff_active:
555	        if logdiff_histogram is None:
556	            logdiff_histogram = torch.zeros(
557	                _LOGDIFF_HISTOGRAM_BINS + 1,
558	                device=values.device,
559	                dtype=torch.float64,
560	            )
561	        if logdiff_min_max is None:
562	            logdiff_min_max = torch.tensor(
563	                [float("inf"), float("-inf")],
564	                device=values.device,
565	                dtype=torch.float64,
566	            )
567	        dist.all_reduce(logdiff_histogram, op=dist.ReduceOp.SUM, group=parallel_state.intra_dp_cp.group)
568	        logdiff_min = logdiff_min_max[0].clone()
569	        logdiff_max = logdiff_min_max[1].clone()
570	        dist.all_reduce(logdiff_min, op=dist.ReduceOp.MIN, group=parallel_state.intra_dp_cp.group)
571	        dist.all_reduce(logdiff_max, op=dist.ReduceOp.MAX, group=parallel_state.intra_dp_cp.group)
572	        logdiff_min_max = torch.stack([logdiff_min, logdiff_max])
573	
574	    loss_reduced = {}
575	    values = values.tolist()
576	    num_samples_or_tokens = values[0]
577	
578	    if num_samples_or_tokens == 0:
579	        # All ranks dropped the batch — typically because an upstream micro-batch
580	        # raised OOM and produced an empty per-token / per-sample contribution.
581	        # Without this guard ``value / 0`` raises ZeroDivisionError, which has
582	        # been observed to take down whole chunk-ablation suites (the ``none``
583	        # mode under long context, see exp_log/tp_sweep_*_70k_*_none*.log).
584	        # Returning zero-valued metrics lets the caller continue logging and
585	        # advance to the next step, so a single OOM doesn't poison subsequent
586	        # cases or hide the real failure under a generic Python error.
587	        logger.warning(
588	            "aggregate_train_losses: num_samples_or_tokens=0 after dp_cp all-reduce; "
589	            "every rank produced an empty contribution (likely OOM). "
590	            "Returning zero-valued metrics to keep the run alive."
591	        )
592	        return {key: 0.0 for key in keys}
593	
594	    for key, value in zip(keys, values[1:], strict=False):
595	        loss_reduced[key] = value * parallel_state.cp.size / num_samples_or_tokens
596	
597	    if weighted_metrics:
598	        for key, numerator_denominator in weighted_metrics.items():
599	            numerator, denominator = numerator_denominator.tolist()
600	            loss_reduced[key] = numerator / denominator if denominator != 0 else 0.0
601	
602	    if logdiff_histogram is not None and logdiff_min_max is not None and logdiff_histogram.sum().item() > 0:
603	        logdiff_min, logdiff_max = logdiff_min_max.tolist()
604	        for tag, quantile in _LOGDIFF_QUANTILES.items():
605	            loss_reduced[f"logdiff_{tag}"] = _logdiff_quantile_from_histogram(
606	                logdiff_histogram,
607	                quantile,
608	                logdiff_max,
609	            )
610	        loss_reduced["logdiff_min"] = logdiff_min
611	        loss_reduced["logdiff_max"] = logdiff_max
612	
613	    return loss_reduced

616	def log_train_step(
617	    args: Namespace,
618	    loss_dict: dict[str, float],
619	    grad_norm: float,
620	    rollout_id: int,
621	    step_id: int,
622	    num_steps_per_rollout: int,
623	    role: str = "actor",
624	    extra_metrics: dict[str, float] | None = None,
625	    should_log: bool | None = None,
626	) -> dict[str, float]:
627	    """Log training metrics for one step.
628	
629	    Formats loss metrics, gradient norm, and extra metrics (e.g., learning rates, MTP loss) for tracking.
630	
631	    Args:
632	        args: Configuration.
633	        loss_dict: Dictionary of loss metrics from aggregate_train_losses.
634	        grad_norm: Gradient norm after clipping.
635	        rollout_id: Rollout ID.
636	        step_id: Step ID within the rollout.
637	        num_steps_per_rollout: Total number of steps per rollout.
638	        role: Role name (e.g., "actor", "critic").
639	        extra_metrics: Optional extra metrics to log (e.g., learning rates, MTP loss).
640	        should_log: Optional override for logging condition. If None, uses rank == 0.
641	
642	    Returns:
643	        The formatted log_dict (for CI tests or other uses).
644	    """
645	    accumulated_step_id = rollout_id * num_steps_per_rollout + step_id
646	    role_tag = "" if role == "actor" else f"{role}-"
647	
648	    log_dict_out = {
649	        f"train/{role_tag}{key}": val.mean().item() if isinstance(val, torch.Tensor) else val
650	        for key, val in loss_dict.items()
651	    }
652	    log_dict_out[f"train/{role_tag}grad_norm"] = float(grad_norm)
653	
654	    if extra_metrics:
655	        for key, val in extra_metrics.items():
656	            log_dict_out[f"train/{role_tag}{key}"] = val
657	
658	    log_dict_out["train/step"] = accumulated_step_id
659	
660	    if should_log is None:
661	        should_log = dist.get_rank() == 0
662	
663	    if should_log:
664	        tracking_utils.log(args, log_dict_out, step_key="train/step")
665	        logger.info(f"{role_tag}step {accumulated_step_id}: {log_dict_out}")
666	
667	    flush_logdiff_histogram()
668	
669	    return log_dict_out

import logging
from argparse import Namespace
from math import isclose

import numpy as np
import psutil
import torch
import torch.distributed as dist

from miles.utils import train_metric_utils
from miles.utils.flops_utils import calculate_fwd_flops
from miles.utils.metric_utils import compute_grpo_sample_metrics, compute_pass_rate, compute_rollout_step
from miles.utils.types import RolloutBatch

from ...utils import tracking_utils
from .cp_utils import get_sum_of_sample_mean
from .data import DataIterator
from .loss import flush_logdiff_histogram
from .parallel import get_parallel_state

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

_LOGDIFF_HISTOGRAM_BINS = 4096
_LOGDIFF_HISTOGRAM_MIN_EXP = -8
_LOGDIFF_HISTOGRAM_MAX_EXP = 2
_LOGDIFF_QUANTILES = {
    "p10": 0.1,
    "p20": 0.2,
    "p30": 0.3,
    "p40": 0.4,
    "p50": 0.5,
    "p60": 0.6,
    "p70": 0.7,
    "p75": 0.75,
    "p80": 0.8,
    "p90": 0.9,
    "p95": 0.95,
    "p999": 0.999,
}
# When train_rollout_kl is logged, these weighted metrics must be all-reduced in a
# fixed order so CP ranks that lack a local shard still enter the same collectives.
_LOGDIFF_WEIGHTED_METRIC_KEYS = ("ess_ratio", "logdiff_token_max_per_sample")


def _logdiff_quantile_from_histogram(counts: torch.Tensor, q: float, max_value: float) -> float:
    total = int(counts.sum().item())
    if total <= 0:
        return 0.0

    target_idx = min(int(q * total), total - 1)
    bucket_idx = int(torch.searchsorted(torch.cumsum(counts, dim=0), target_idx + 1).item())
    if bucket_idx == 0:
        return 0.0
    if bucket_idx >= _LOGDIFF_HISTOGRAM_BINS:
        return max_value

    edges = torch.logspace(
        _LOGDIFF_HISTOGRAM_MIN_EXP,
        _LOGDIFF_HISTOGRAM_MAX_EXP,
        steps=_LOGDIFF_HISTOGRAM_BINS,
        device=counts.device,
        dtype=torch.float64,
    )
    return float(edges[bucket_idx].item())


def _cat_per_sample_tensors(values: list[torch.Tensor]) -> torch.Tensor:
    """Concatenate per-sample tensors along dim 0; promote 0-D tensors so ``torch.cat`` succeeds."""
    if not values:
        raise ValueError("_cat_per_sample_tensors: empty tensor list")
    normalized = [t.unsqueeze(0) if t.dim() == 0 else t for t in values]
    return torch.cat(normalized, dim=0)


def gather_log_data(
    metric_name: str,
    args: Namespace,
    rollout_id: int,
    log_dict: dict[str, float],
) -> dict[str, float] | None:
    """
    Gather per-rank metrics, reduce by mean on the DP source rank, and log.

    Expects `log_dict` to contain plain scalars. The DP source rank prints and
    optionally logs to WandB/TensorBoard with a step derived from `rollout_id` and
    batch sizes. Returns the reduced dict on the DP source rank; returns None on others.
    """

    parallel_state = get_parallel_state()

    pg = parallel_state.intra_dp_cp
    dp_size = pg.size
    gathered_log_dict = [None] * dp_size
    # Not sure if this will be a performance bottleneck.
    dist.gather_object(
        log_dict,
        gathered_log_dict if pg.rank == 0 else None,
        dst=dist.get_global_rank(pg.gloo_group, 0),
        group=pg.gloo_group,
    )

    if pg.rank == 0:
        reduced_log_dict = {
            f"{metric_name}/{key}": sum([d[key] for d in gathered_log_dict]) / dp_size for key in log_dict
        }
        logger.info(f"{metric_name} {rollout_id}: {reduced_log_dict}")

        # Calculate step once to avoid duplication
        step = compute_rollout_step(args, rollout_id)
        reduced_log_dict["rollout/step"] = step
        tracking_utils.log(args, reduced_log_dict, step_key="rollout/step")

        return reduced_log_dict
    else:
        return None


def aggregate_forward_results(
    forward_data_store: list[dict[str, list]],
    data_iterator: DataIterator,
    args: Namespace,
    store_prefix: str = "",
) -> dict[str, list]:
    rollout_data = {}
    if not forward_data_store:
        return rollout_data

    keys = forward_data_store[0].keys()
    for key in keys:
        values = []
        for batch_result in forward_data_store:
            assert isinstance(batch_result[key], list), f"Expected list for key {key}, got {type(batch_result[key])}"
            values += batch_result[key]

        # Handle dynamic batch size: restore original order
        if args.use_dynamic_batch_size and hasattr(data_iterator, "micro_batch_indices"):
            origin_values = [None] * len(values)
            origin_indices = sum(data_iterator.micro_batch_indices, [])
            for value, origin_index in zip(values, origin_indices, strict=False):
                origin_values[origin_index] = value
            values = origin_values

        rollout_data[key] = values

    return rollout_data


def log_rollout_data(rollout_id: int, args: Namespace, rollout_data: RolloutBatch) -> None:
    """
    Summarize rollout fields and log reduced metrics on PP last stage, TP rank 0.

    - Tensor-valued lists are concatenated and averaged. For token-level metrics
      like log-probs/returns/advantages/values, computes a CP-correct sample mean
      using `loss_masks` and total/response lengths.
    - Non-tensor lists are averaged elementwise.
    - Scalars are converted to Python numbers.
    """
    parallel_state = get_parallel_state()
    if parallel_state.tp.rank == 0 and parallel_state.is_pp_last_stage:
        cp_size = parallel_state.cp.size
        log_dict = {}
        response_lengths = rollout_data["response_lengths"]
        loss_masks = rollout_data["loss_masks"]
        total_lengths = rollout_data["total_lengths"]
        max_seq_lens = rollout_data.get("max_seq_lens", None)

        env_errors = rollout_data.get("env_error")
        if env_errors:
            env_error_total = sum(env_errors)
            log_dict["env_error_ratio"] = env_error_total / len(env_errors)

        for key, val in rollout_data.items():
            if key in [
                "tokens",
                "multimodal_train_inputs",
                "loss_masks",
                "sample_indices",
                "rollout_routed_experts",
                "rollout_routed_experts_weights",
                "max_seq_lens",
                "dynamic_global_batch_size",
                "env_error",
                "weight_versions",
                "metadata",
            ]:
                continue
            # Upload per sample mean for each rollout value
            # There are the following assumptions:
            # - Each dp rank has the same number of samples
            if isinstance(val, (list, tuple)):
                if isinstance(val[0], torch.Tensor):
                    # NOTE: Here we have to do the clone().detach(), otherwise the tensor will be
                    # modified in place and will cause problem for the next rollout.
                    val = _cat_per_sample_tensors(val).clone().detach()
                    if key in [
                        "log_probs",
                        "ref_log_probs",
                        "rollout_log_probs",
                        "returns",
                        "advantages",
                        "values",
                        "entropy",
                    ]:
                        sum_of_sample_mean = get_sum_of_sample_mean(
                            total_lengths,
                            response_lengths,
                            loss_masks,
                            qkv_format=args.qkv_format,
                            max_seq_lens=max_seq_lens,
                        )
                        val = cp_size * sum_of_sample_mean(val) / len(loss_masks)
                    else:
                        val = val.mean() * cp_size
                else:
                    # Flatten nested lists (e.g. list of lists from async rollout).
                    flat = val
                    if isinstance(val[0], (list, tuple)):
                        flat = [x for sublist in val for x in sublist]
                    # Skip non-numeric values (e.g. strings from async rollout metadata).
                    if flat and not isinstance(flat[0], (int, float)):
                        continue
                    if key == "raw_reward" and env_errors:
                        filtered = [v for v, e in zip(flat, env_errors) if not e]
                        val = sum(filtered) / len(filtered) if filtered else 0
                    else:
                        val = sum(flat) / len(flat)
            elif isinstance(val, torch.Tensor):
                val = val.float().mean()
            else:
                raise ValueError(f"Unsupported type: {type(val)} for key: {key}")
            log_dict[key] = val.item() if isinstance(val, torch.Tensor) else val

        reduced_log_dict = gather_log_data("rollout", args, rollout_id, log_dict)
        if args.ci_test and not args.ci_disable_logprobs_checker and reduced_log_dict is not None:
            if (
                rollout_id == 0
                and "rollout/log_probs" in reduced_log_dict
                and "rollout/ref_log_probs" in reduced_log_dict
            ):
                # When R3 (rollout routing replay) is enabled, ref model does not use R3
                # so log_probs and ref_log_probs may diverge; use a relaxed tolerance.
                # When --sglang-config deploys multiple models, the heavier offload/onload
                # cycle can amplify flash-attention non-determinism; use 1e-8.
                # The default branch also covers larger TP/CP/EP variants (e.g. stage-c-long
                # test_qwen2.5_0.5B_gsm8k.py on 8 GPUs hit ~3.7e-9 diff in CI), so use 1e-8
                # rather than the previous 3e-9 to absorb BF16 reduction noise across configs.
                if args.use_rollout_routing_replay:
                    abs_tol = 1e-5
                elif getattr(args, "sglang_config", None) is not None:
                    abs_tol = 1e-8
                else:
                    abs_tol = 1e-8
                assert isclose(
                    reduced_log_dict["rollout/log_probs"], reduced_log_dict["rollout/ref_log_probs"], abs_tol=abs_tol
                ), f"CI check failed: log_probs ({reduced_log_dict['rollout/log_probs']}) != ref_log_probs ({reduced_log_dict['rollout/ref_log_probs']})"
            if "rollout/log_probs" in reduced_log_dict and "rollout/rollout_log_probs" in reduced_log_dict:
                assert isclose(
                    reduced_log_dict["rollout/log_probs"], reduced_log_dict["rollout/rollout_log_probs"], abs_tol=0.03
                ), f"CI check failed: log_probs ({reduced_log_dict['rollout/log_probs']}) != rollout_log_probs ({reduced_log_dict['rollout/rollout_log_probs']})"
            if "rollout/entropy" in reduced_log_dict:
                assert 0 < reduced_log_dict["rollout/entropy"] < 0.7

        if args.ci_test and args.true_on_policy_mode:
            assert log_dict["log_probs"] == log_dict["rollout_log_probs"], (
                f"CI check failed: true_on_policy_mode is enabled, but log_probs "
                f"({log_dict['log_probs']}) != rollout_log_probs "
                f"({log_dict['rollout_log_probs']})"
            )

    if args.log_multi_turn:
        log_multi_turn_data(rollout_id, args, rollout_data)
    if args.log_passrate:
        log_passrate(rollout_id, args, rollout_data)

    if args.n_samples_per_prompt > 1:
        log_grpo_metrics(rollout_id, args, rollout_data, parallel_state)

    if args.log_correct_samples:
        if parallel_state.tp.rank == 0 and parallel_state.is_pp_last_stage:
            cp_size = parallel_state.cp.size
            log_dict = {}
            response_lengths = rollout_data["response_lengths"]
            loss_masks = rollout_data["loss_masks"]
            total_lengths = rollout_data["total_lengths"]

            def quantile(total_value, n_quantiles, data) -> dict:
                import math

                assert n_quantiles > 1, f"n_quantiles({n_quantiles}) must be greater than 1."

                quantiles = [((i + 1) / n_quantiles) for i in range(n_quantiles)]
                cut_points = [total_value * q for q in quantiles]
                cut_points[-1] = total_value

                count = [0] * n_quantiles
                for d in data:
                    for i, point in enumerate(cut_points):
                        if d <= point:
                            count[i] += 1
                            break

                total = sum(count) + 1e-9
                percentile = [c / total for c in count]

                percentile = {f"p{min(math.ceil(q*100),100)}": p for q, p in zip(quantiles, percentile, strict=True)}
                return percentile

            raw_rewards = rollout_data["raw_reward"]
            # Additional metrics for correct cases are calculated separately below.
            correct_response_lengths = []
            correct_total_lengths = []
            correct_loss_masks = []
            correct_entropy = []
            for i, raw_reward in enumerate(raw_rewards):
                if raw_reward == 1:
                    correct_response_lengths.append(response_lengths[i])
                    correct_total_lengths.append(total_lengths[i])
                    correct_loss_masks.append(loss_masks[i])
                    correct_entropy.append(-rollout_data["log_probs"][i])
            num_correct_responses = len(correct_total_lengths)
            rollout_data["correct_response_lengths"] = correct_response_lengths
            correct_response_length_percentile = quantile(
                args.rollout_max_response_len, 4, rollout_data["correct_response_lengths"]
            )
            for p, val in correct_response_length_percentile.items():
                rollout_data[f"correct_length/{p}"] = [val] * num_correct_responses
            if len(correct_entropy) > 0:
                sum_of_sample_mean = get_sum_of_sample_mean(
                    correct_total_lengths, correct_response_lengths, correct_loss_masks
                )
                correct_entropy = sum_of_sample_mean(torch.cat(correct_entropy, dim=0))
                rollout_data["correct_entropy"] = [correct_entropy.item()] * num_correct_responses
            else:
                rollout_data["correct_entropy"] = [0] * num_correct_responses


def log_multi_turn_data(rollout_id: int, args: Namespace, rollout_data: RolloutBatch) -> None:
    """
    Log multi-turn auxiliary metrics such as raw/observed response lengths and rounds.

    Operates only on PP last stage and TP rank 0. Uses GPU tensors when available
    to compute statistics without host transfers.
    """
    parallel_state = get_parallel_state()
    if parallel_state.tp.rank == 0 and parallel_state.is_pp_last_stage:
        log_dict = {}
        for key, val in rollout_data.items():
            if key == "loss_masks":
                if val:  # Check if val is not empty
                    device = val[0].device  # Get device from first tensor

                    # Vectorized length calculation using torch
                    raw_response_lengths = torch.tensor([v.shape[0] for v in val], dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
                    log_dict["raw_response_length/response_length_mean"] = raw_response_lengths.mean().item()
                    log_dict["raw_response_length/response_length_max"] = raw_response_lengths.max().item()
                    log_dict["raw_response_length/response_length_min"] = raw_response_lengths.min().item()
                    log_dict["raw_response_length/response_length_clip_ratio"] = (
                        (raw_response_lengths >= args.rollout_max_response_len).float().mean().item()
                    )

                    # Vectorized sum calculation using torch - stay on GPU
                    wo_obs_response_lengths = torch.tensor(
                        [v.sum().item() for v in val], dtype=torch.float32, device=device
                    )
                    log_dict["wo_obs_response_length/response_length_mean"] = wo_obs_response_lengths.mean().item()
                    log_dict["wo_obs_response_length/response_length_max"] = wo_obs_response_lengths.max().item()
                    log_dict["wo_obs_response_length/response_length_min"] = wo_obs_response_lengths.min().item()
            if key == "round_number":
                # Use numpy for vectorized round number statistics
                round_number_array = np.array(val)
                log_dict["multi_turn_metric/round_number_mean"] = np.mean(round_number_array)
                log_dict["multi_turn_metric/round_number_max"] = np.max(round_number_array)
                log_dict["multi_turn_metric/round_number_min"] = np.min(round_number_array)
        gather_log_data("multi_turn", args, rollout_id, log_dict)


def log_passrate(rollout_id: int, args: Namespace, rollout_data: RolloutBatch) -> None:
    """
    Compute pass@k metrics from `raw_reward` groups and log the results.

    `raw_reward` is reshaped to `[group_number, group_size]`, then pass@k is
    estimated per problem and averaged.
    """
    parallel_state = get_parallel_state()
    if parallel_state.tp.rank == 0 and parallel_state.is_pp_last_stage:
        log_dict = {}
        for key, val in rollout_data.items():
            if key != "raw_reward":
                continue

            log_dict |= compute_pass_rate(
                flat_rewards=val,
                group_size=args.n_samples_per_prompt,
                num_groups=args.rollout_batch_size,
            )

        gather_log_data("passrate", args, rollout_id, log_dict)


def log_grpo_metrics(
    rollout_id: int, args: Namespace, rollout_data: RolloutBatch, parallel_state
) -> None:
    """
    Compute GRPO group-level metrics and log them.

    For each prompt group of n samples:
    - solve_all  / all_one_ratio  : variance<0.01 and mean>0.99 (all correct, no gradient signal)
    - solve_none / all_zero_ratio : variance<0.01 and mean<0.01 (all wrong, no gradient signal)
    - no_grad                     : variance<0.01 (no gradient signal regardless of correctness)
    - effective_ratio             : 1 - no_grad (fraction of groups that DO produce gradient)
    - {all_one,all_zero,effective}_count : absolute counts (denominator = num_groups)

    Also emits a single human-friendly INFO line per rollout to make signal collapse
    visible at a glance when scrolling raw stdout/stderr (TB shows the same numbers).
    """
    if parallel_state.tp.rank == 0 and parallel_state.is_pp_last_stage:
        log_dict = {}
        if "raw_reward" in rollout_data:
            log_dict |= compute_grpo_sample_metrics(
                flat_rewards=rollout_data["raw_reward"],
                group_size=args.n_samples_per_prompt,
                num_groups=args.rollout_batch_size,
            )

        if log_dict:
            if parallel_state.intra_dp_cp.rank == 0 and "num_groups" in log_dict:
                ng = int(log_dict["num_groups"])
                a1 = int(log_dict["all_one_count"])
                a0 = int(log_dict["all_zero_count"])
                eff = int(log_dict["effective_count"])
                logger.info(
                    f"[grpo_signal] rollout={rollout_id}  groups={ng}  "
                    f"all_one={a1} ({a1 / ng:.0%})  "
                    f"all_zero={a0} ({a0 / ng:.0%})  "
                    f"effective={eff} ({eff / ng:.0%})"
                )
            gather_log_data("grpo_metrics", args, rollout_id, log_dict)

def log_cpu_memory(rollout_id: int, args: Namespace, label: str) -> None:
    """Log current system CPU memory usage to wandb/tensorboard.

    Caller is responsible for ensuring this runs on a single rank only.
    """

    cpu_mem_gb = psutil.virtual_memory().used / 1e9
    step = compute_rollout_step(args, rollout_id)
    logger.info(f"[CPU memory] {label}: {cpu_mem_gb:.2f} GB (rollout_id={rollout_id}, step={step})")
    tracking_utils.log(
